Real pages interrupt you: a promo overlay, a cookie banner, a tip that appears
after load. A robust test handles the interruption explicitly — dismiss it, and
**wait for it to leave** before continuing, so a later click isn't intercepted.

The catalog page takes an `?overlay=1` flag that shows a dismissible promo
overlay. Handle it.

## Task 1 — Dismiss a promo overlay before continuing

**Goal:** create `checks/robust.robot` that opens the catalog with the overlay,
asserts it is visible, dismisses it, and **waits for it to detach** before
reading the catalog underneath.

Here is the same `Wait For Elements State` pattern over a different transition —
waiting for the catalog title to appear after sign-in. Adapt it to the overlay.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Wait For The Catalog To Appear
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Wait For Elements State    data-testid=catalog-title    visible
    Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** the test waits for the overlay's state with `Wait For Elements State`.

<!-- hint -->
Open the overlay with `New Page    ${BASE_URL}/catalog?overlay=1`, confirm it with
`Get Element States    data-testid=promo-overlay    contains    visible`, then
`Click    data-testid=notice-close`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Wait for it to leave before continuing:
`Wait For Elements State    data-testid=promo-overlay    detached`, then read the
catalog underneath.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Dismiss The Promo Overlay
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/catalog?overlay=1
    Get Element States    data-testid=promo-overlay    contains    visible
    Click    data-testid=notice-close
    Wait For Elements State    data-testid=promo-overlay    detached
    Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run it green

Run:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

**Check:** the overlay is dismissed and the catalog is reachable underneath.
